dedupe_keys.name: dataset for how instrument transformers influence power quality measurements a proposal of accuracy verification tests

description: Crotti Gabriella and colleagues publish this resource through the source community. The spreadsheet provides time-domain data for tests on an inductive voltage transformer, supporting the power-quality accuracy-verification study in Sensors 22:5847. Coverage is the named instrument experiment; sampling interval, signal duration and uncertainty columns are not stated in the native abstract. The source establishes its role in evaluating how instrument transformers influence grid-quality measurements. Proposed test procedures and collected waveforms are kept distinct; the record does not assert adoption of a new international standard. Zenodo supplies the deposited data and native file inventory with open access under cc-by-4.0. Sample values, linked files and code were not read or executed during source checks. A limitation is that complete implementation or measurement settings cannot be reconstructed from descriptive metadata alone. Related experimental components and publications retain their distinct roles; separate deposits are not assumed to provide independent observations.
